noApp: Add your Spotify app before connecting your account.
noToken: Spotify reused your consent, so no fresh token was issued. Revoke this app in your Spotify account page, then connect again.
oauth: Spotify refused the sign-in. Try connecting again.
state: The sign-in link expired or was replayed. Start the connect again.
store: The token could not be stored. Try again in a moment.
unconfigured: Song requests are not configured on this deployment yet: the Spotify callback URL is missing. Ask the operator to set SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI.
cost: Enter a whole number of points, at least 1.
cooldown: Enter a cooldown between 0 seconds and 7 days.
